source.name: Tranco
source.description: A reproducible research ranking of popular domains; used as a popularity proxy, not direct traffic measurement.

methodology.pageScope: One public homepage per ranked domain.
methodology.evidenceScope: Static response source only; no JavaScript execution, login, cookies, or screenshots.
methodology.robotsPolicy: The research crawler checks robots.txt before fetching a homepage and records exclusions.
methodology.afterPolicy: After-state visuals are illustrative design targets, never measured outcomes for third-party sites.

audit.note: Raw crawl records remain immutable. Only rows inside these audited ranges, and only when their raw state and error code match this manifest, are reclassified in derived snapshots.
